relationships.alice-ascaride: Sends her and lends Azure Gate knives for escape.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Part of the League mobilization that brings her to Caldia ahead of main reinforcements.

periods.summary: Norman is not directly onstage, but his preparations shape the crisis response. Before Alice Ascaride enters Quedland, he lends her several Azure Gate knives so she can escape if necessary; she uses one to teleport Stella, Ikki, Lunaeyes, and herself from Luxel to Freyaveg. Later Nene explains that the League chancellor has begun mobilizing all available Mage-Knights and national forces, with up to a million reinforcements expected, until Lunaeyes' declaration rejects League intervention.

key_events.summary: Alice uses Norman's Azure Gate knife to evacuate the heroes.
His broader emergency mobilization brings Nene and promised reinforcements.
The planned League intervention is politically blocked by Lunaeyes' declaration.
